decision: Started the Last Keep v1 run from CONCEPT.md and an empty repo
why: The owner asked for a playable co-op game, tests, and a deploy to agentyard.letz.tw

decision: Done means the site serves the game, a WebSocket joins a room, CI is green, and the PR is merged
why: Those are the checks the owner named

decision: One pure State and a Sim.tick reducer inside a room GenServer
why: The owner fixed the process model, and a second design pass would restate it

decision: Full JSON snapshots at 20 Hz, public player ids, secret reconnect tokens
why: Deltas and shared tokens were the wrong risks for fifteen players

decision: Installed pstack with npx skills add backnotprop/pstack --agent cursor --copy
why: Future agents in this repo need the skills, and the CLI wrote them to .agents/skills

decision: Kept hero kits, wave plans, and building costs in tables
why: The tick should read data instead of growing a new branch per hero

decision: The game-over overlay was painting over the match because display:grid beat the hidden attribute
why: Clicks missed the join form and the canvas read as black

decision: Dusk lighting stays readable after the Lambert 1/pi shade, and trees sit inside the first camera view
why: A black frame is not a playable keep

decision: Build highlight updates from the key and click that change it
why: A 100ms repaint was only there to refresh that highlight

decision: Wave-1 goblins render on the yard, and an invite with name and hero joins at once
why: A missing facing made the mesh rotation NaN, spawn sat outside the camera, and the join page ignored the query

decision: The night waits for the host, goblins stand on the yard inside a keep-centered camera, and a tap places or attacks
why: The browser proof counted a crest while heroes stood still, so edge labels and a missed click still wiped a real pair of players
